name: Relationship Mirror
summary: A six-card dyadic spread mapping two individuals, their mutual connection, underlying roots, and relational trajectory.
author: Traditional

instructions.preparation: Ground your heart center. Hold the shared connection in conscious presence.
instructions.shuffle: Shuffle while acknowledging both subjective experiences without prejudice.
instructions.drawing: Card 1 (Left column: Querent), Card 2 (Right column: Partner), Card 3 (Center top: The Connection), Card 4 (Center bottom: Foundation), Card 5 (Bridge: Friction/Challenge), Card 6 (Crown: Potential).
instructions.synthesis: Observe how Card 1 mirrors Card 2, how Card 4 supports Card 3, and how Card 5 tests the union.

slots.description: How the querent perceives the relationship, feelings, and behavioral posture.
How the other party feels, current disposition, and unspoken desires.
The active chemistry, shared communication field, and current synergy between both.
The shared history, core values, or karmic agreements bonding the couple.
Misunderstandings, external strains, or shadow projections hindering unity.
Where the partnership is heading if mutual understanding is cultivated.
